name: Perils of Salvaging (The Perimeter, 2070)
description: Neon At Home's 2070 version of Salvaging Night City's tables, for the Night City of the Edgerunner's Handbook. Import this table to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy. Edit a result's wording and Neon At Home shows yours; the peril's dice stay the module's.

results.text: An abandoned motel's roof caves in on you. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), and a Critical Injury to the Body.
Raiders, or a Nomad family who found it first. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
Unexploded ordnance from the Unification War. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
Into a dry well or a service pit. A 30m fall when the ground gives: 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), unless a Grapple Hand or Gun, or a DV15 Athletics Check to grab the edge, saves you.
A ruptured CHOOH2 tank. A pocket of toxic gas for a round, as a Vial of Biotoxin: beat DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs or take 3d6 straight to HP. An Anti-Smog Breathing Mask or an air supply keeps it off.
A "dead" substation that isn't. A live wire: electrocuted for a round, 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
